message: Desk 0.1.36 fixes the first sign-in flashing and locking. Signing in once on Tools or the site now sticks on Tools, the site and Desk; Desk no longer reads a stale or just-minted gate as a website Lock.
chromiumMessage: Click Download update, unzip Black.Forest.Desk-chromium.zip over your Desk folder, then press Reload Desk.
